context_note: Vérino (host of the Montreux gala) on a corporate gig: he mocks a 'drunk' guy slowly walking to the toilets... who turns out to have hip prostheses. The joke is on the comedian himself. Seminar intro and the 'hypotenuse/timing' aside are cut for length; ends on the reveal.
